commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' RB Leipzig take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+5' Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
90+3' Ole Werner has decided to substitute Romulo Cardoso and he is replaced by Andrija Maksimovic (RB Leipzig).

90+2' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) leaps high near the penalty spot and gets a header in from the free kick. It's on target, but the goalkeeper dives to his left to save the effort. It was a difficult header and it's always tough to put the ball inside the net from positions like that.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

90' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Peter Gulacsi sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom left corner.
90' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Dortmund comes to nothing.
90' The resulting set piece from Dortmund is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
89' Substitution. Johan Bakayoko makes his way off the pitch and Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) comes on as his replacement.
89' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) latches on to a sweet cross into the box and misses with a header way wide of the left post.
88' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
86' Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Sascha Stegemann ignores the protests.
86' One of the RB Leipzig players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
